message.content: {"note_claim": "A state Real ID is a state-issued identity card, not an immigration document.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "The federal REAL ID Act of 2005 establishes minimum standards for state-issued driver's licenses and identification cards that will be accepted as identification for certain official federal purposes.", "reason": "The page consistently describes REAL ID as a state-issued driver's license/identification card, directly supporting the note's characterization of it as a state-issued identity card rather than an immigration document."}

parsed.note_claim: A state Real ID is a state-issued identity card, not an immigration document.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The federal REAL ID Act of 2005 establishes minimum standards for state-issued driver's licenses and identification cards that will be accepted as identification for certain official federal purposes.
